content:
We have carbon NMR data: chemical shifts: 166.40, 131.87, 129.70 (twice), 129.01 (twice), 129.00, 52.24, 43.47, 38.60.

We need number of CH3 groups (methyl). Need to infer structure. Carbon shifts: 166.40 likely carbonyl (C=O). Aromatic carbons around 129-132. Then aliphatic: 52.24, 43.47, 38.60. Those could be CH3, CH2, etc. Need to determine which are methyl.

We could also get proton NMR to see methyl signals. Let's get proton NMR.
